public_context.environment_introduction:
# Environment Information

## Brief Introduction:  
This environment is a review management component within an e-commerce platform, where detailed records of products—including dietary supplements—are maintained with unique identifiers.  
Users submit reviews that are linked to products using these IDs, and the system persists, organizes, and exposes this data for retrieval and analysis.  
It naturally supports querying capabilities to fetch all reviews for any given product, fulfilling tasks related to consumer feedback and product reputation.

## Environment Rules / Constraints:  
- Each review must be linked to an existing product via product_id.
- Reviews can only be retrieved for products that exist in the system.
- Reviews may be subject to moderation before being visible in queries (based on moderation_status).
- Users may be limited to one review per product.
public_context.task:
Prepare reviews for the upcoming campaign and seed a verified review:

1. For the product named “Trailblazer Hiking Backpack,” approve all pending reviews that are authored by active accounts and have a rating of 4 or 5. Reject any pending reviews on this product authored by non-active accounts.
2. For the product named “Sunview Cast Iron Skillet,” reject all pending reviews authored by disabled accounts.
3. For the product named “OceanMist Water Bottle,” delete any rejected reviews dated before 2023-01-01.
4. Register a new user with user_id USR106, username “Lena Park,” and account_status “active.”
5. Submit a new 5-star review for “Sunview Cast Iron Skillet” by USR106 with the text: “Heats evenly and maintains seasoning well. Outstanding sear; worth the weight.” After submission, approve this review.
   - Ensure the one-review-per-product-per-user rule is respected. If USR106 already has a review for the skillet, edit that existing review to match the provided rating and text, then approve it.

function.description:

Args:

Returns:

function.name: get_product_by_id

function.description:
Retrieve the full list of products in the system.

Args:
    None

Returns:

        "success": True,

    }

    - If no products exist, the returned list is empty but still a success.
function.name: list_all_products

function.description:
Retrieve all reviews attached to a given product by product_id.
Only reviews with appropriate moderation_status ("approved") are returned.

Args:
    product_id (str): The product identifier to fetch reviews for.

Returns:
    dict:
      - Success: { "success": True, "data": List[ReviewInfo] }
      - Failure: { "success": False, "error": "Product does not exist." }

Constraints:
    - Product must exist in the system.
    - Only reviews with moderation_status=="approved" are returned.
function.name: get_reviews_for_product

function.description:
Retrieve all reviews for a product, filtered by the provided moderation_status.

Args:
    product_id (str): Unique identifier for the product.
    moderation_status (str): Only reviews with this moderation status will be returned (e.g. "approved", "pending").

Returns:
    dict: 
        If product exists:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": List[ReviewInfo]  # May be empty if no matching reviews.
            }
        If product does not exist:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "Product does not exist"
            }

Constraints:
    - Only reviews for products actually present are allowed.
    - Only reviews with matching moderation_status will be returned.
function.name: get_reviews_for_product_by_status

function.description:
Retrieve details for a specific review given its review_id.

Args:
    review_id (str): Unique identifier of the review to retrieve.

Returns:
    dict: 
        Success: {
            "success": True,
            "data": ReviewInfo  # full info of the matched review
        }
        Failure: {
            "success": False,
            "error": "Review not found"
        }

Constraints:
    - Review with matching review_id must exist in the system.
    - No moderation_status filtering is applied for direct lookup.
function.name: get_review_by_id

function.description:
Retrieve user details using their user_id.

Args:
    user_id (str): Unique identifier for the user.

Returns:
    dict:
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": UserInfo  # User's details
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Reason (e.g., 'User not found')
            }

Constraints:
    - The user_id must exist in the system.
function.name: get_user_by_id

function.description:
List all reviews authored by the specified user.

Args:
    user_id (str): The ID of the user for whom to retrieve reviews.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: {
            "success": True,
            "data": List[ReviewInfo]  # list of reviews (can be empty)
        }
        - On failure: {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # reason for failure, e.g. user does not exist
        }

function.name: get_reviews_by_user

function.description:
Check whether the given user has already reviewed the specified product.

Args:
    user_id (str): Unique identifier of the user.
    product_id (str): Unique identifier of the product.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": bool  # True if the user has a review for the product, else False.
    } or {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error.
    }

Constraints:
    - The user and product must exist.
function.name: has_user_reviewed_product

function.description:
Submit a new review for a product by a user.

Enforces constraint: one review per product per user.

Args:
    product_id (str): Target product's unique ID.
    user_id (str): User's unique ID.
    rating (int): Numerical rating for the product.
    review_text (str): The actual feedback text.
    timestamp (str): ISO string or similar representation of review time.
    moderation_status (str): Initial moderation status for the review.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Review added",
        "review_id": <str>
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Product/User doesn't exist, or user already reviewed product"
    }

Constraints:
    - Product must exist.
    - User must exist.
    - One review per product per user.
    - Unique review_id per review.
function.name: add_review

function.description:
Change the moderation_status of a review (e.g., approve or reject).

Args:
    review_id (str): Unique identifier of the review to update.
    new_status (str): The target moderation status ("pending", "approved", "rejected").

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success: { "success": True, "message": "Moderation status updated successfully" }
        - On failure: { "success": False, "error": <reason> }

Constraints:
    - The provided review_id must exist in self.reviews.
    - new_status must be one of ["pending", "approved", "rejected"].
function.name: update_review_moderation_status

function.description:
Update the content, rating, timestamp, or other editable fields of a submitted review.

Args:
    review_id (str): Review to update.
    review_text (str, optional): New review text.
    rating (int, optional): New rating.
    timestamp (str, optional): New modification timestamp.
    moderation_status (str, optional): Optionally update moderation status.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Review updated successfully."
    }
    or
    dict: {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - The review must exist.
    - Only specified fields will be updated.
    - Review linkage to user/product cannot be changed.
function.name: edit_review

function.description:

        If not found: {
            "success": False,
            "error": "Review does not exist."
        }

Constraints:

    - Other constraints such as moderation status do not block deletion.

function.description:

    dict: {

        "message": "Product <product_id> added successfully."

    or

        "error": str  # Failure reason (e.g., duplicate product_id)
    }

Constraints:

function.name: add_product

function.description:
Remove a product and all reviews linked to it from the system.

    product_id (str): The unique identifier of the product to delete.

function.description:
